entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, dammit! I wanna move better,[n]but I just can't...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I was trainin' for nationals back in[n]the day... but now I totally suck balls.

entries.speaker: Irritated Voice
entries.en: What the hell do you think you're doing?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Nakaoka... Takeishi...

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: ...Running, huh? I saw you from[n]the window.

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: What, you gonna try to come crawling[n]back to the track team?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? H-Hell no...

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: Hmm...

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: ...Speaking of which, this was your secret[n]training spot, wasn't it?

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: Well, it's our spot now.

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: You know, us. The former track team.

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: We don't even have a locker room[n]anymore, thanks to someone I know.
Let's not fight.[clr 27]
Want to train with us?
It's nice to meet you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We ain't fightin'...

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: Yeah, this isn't anything like a fight.[n]Not even close.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: What the heck is up with this guy?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess it IS the first time you guys're[n]meetin'...

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: Hold on, aren't you that transfer student?[n]You're really gonna hang around with[n]this loser?

entries.speaker: Ex-Track Team Member
entries.en: You better watch out. He'll hit you[n]the second he gets pissed off.

entries.speaker: Ex-Track Team Member
entries.en: I heard his dad was the same way.[n]Like father like son, right? Now that's[n]some scary shit.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That don't got anything to do with this...
Calm down, Ryuji.[clr 27]
Just endure it.
I'll shut them up.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...You're right.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Yeah.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What!? Hey, quit it!

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: Hmph. Guess you two are pretty similar[n]after all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Look, back then, I...

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: I don't need to hear your excuses.

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: Everyone was going through the same[n]bullshit with Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: The beatings, the impossible exercises...[n]but we put up with all of it for the[n]track team.

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: But no. You had to go and fuck all of[n]that up!

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: Man, I was stupid for ever thinking[n]you were my teammate.

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: ...That's all I have to say to you.[n]I'm outta here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I nearly smacked him when he was[n]talkin' about my dad...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I haven't changed at all...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But y'know... you actually helped me[n]calm down a little.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm glad you were here with me.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Thanks, man!
I feel like my bond with Ryuji[n]is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Let's call it a day.

entries.speaker: Familiar Voice
entries.en: Hey, Nakaoka! Why didn't you[n]kick his ass!?

entries.speaker: Familiar Voice
entries.en: ...What?

entries.speaker: Familiar Voice
entries.en: The hell's your problem!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Now they're just arguing with[n]each other...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I should stay out of it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyways, nice trainin' with you.
